_comment: Single source of truth for the Suzuka 1987 course. Geometry hand-traced from tools/suzuka_1987_aerial.jpg via tools/refs/tracer.html, converted by tools/trace_to_track.py (centreline = perpendicular-recentred midpoint of the traced inner/outer edges, half-width = edge-to-edge gap). Edit the trace + re-run trace_to_track.py, then build_track.py.
